# Apollo libvirtualgamepad SDK

Unmodified MIT-licensed client, protocol headers and portable Sony report codecs
from https://github.com/Nonary/libvirtualgamepad at
5a3e4d222dd0b87556d4c564eb58b450ab579fb0 (protocol 2).

The Windows driver is installed separately. The deployment package extracts the
signed driver and usbip-win2 transport from Vibepollo 2.0.4 without installing
or replacing Apollo with Vibepollo. See the deployment report for hashes.
